adjudication.finding: Paused channel after all attempts terminal
adjudication.reason: An actual unrun account-blocked position prevents finiteQueueComplete; a terminal failed final attempt does not undo execution of the finite queue. Research attainment remains separate.

adjudication.finding: Actual skill/model/source metadata duplicated in report
adjudication.reason: Actual thread/start is matched against the exact complete original bundle. Authoritative predispatch claims retain source/model/effort/limits and the runner dispatches those same variables; raw lifecycle remains available.

adjudication.finding: Fallback report order or duplicate mutable report
adjudication.reason: Registered positions always retain ordered attempt IDs, and original report creation is exclusive. No report alias or mutable replacement is used.
